BiblicalUsage: Chabar in Aramaic means a companion, a fellow. When the decree went out to kill the wise men of Babylon, they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain, and Daniel went home and told the thing to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions, so they would pray together for mercy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gives His servants companions for the night the decree goes out. Daniel did not face the king's fury alone, and neither do we.
